{{Quote|Mirax and I were married before I became a Jedi, so I didn't have a Jedi ceremony.|Corran Horn|<ref name="Union 1">[[Union 1|''Union'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''wedding''' of [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]] was a secret ceremony that took place in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]''. It was officiated by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] who was acting as de facto [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the recently captured [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. The wedding was witnessed by their friends [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] and [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]]. The Horns planned to have a more formal wedding back on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="bacta" />
